title: MAP-LOC-the-wandering-briar - The Wandering Briar Location Map

sections.title: Player text
sections.body: A wall of thorn opens where there was only forest a moment ago. The path inside is green, narrow, and warm, as if the briar itself is holding its breath to let you pass. Lantern-light glows deeper in, touching salvaged papers, careful maps, and faces waiting to see what kind of people you are.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Use this Atlas-original optional map only after deep trust; present it as the Union's mobile evidence refuge without treating proposed canon as settled.

sections.title: GM notes
items: Without a guide, outsiders do not arrive.
The place should feel sacred-secret and practical, not villain lair.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: Say: "This location is optional and trust-gated. The briar is not a random hazard; it is a living refuge. If the table reaches it, they earned access to the strongest Act Two evidence without getting the whole campaign answer."

items: bramble_outcome Bramble outcome select unresolved killed captured spared negotiated escaped Requires deep trust route.
